text.tspan: BREAKING NEWS
@unhappychoice storms 13 repos, forcibly evicting bot from git history
TUESDAY CARNAGE
@unhappychoice detonates 206 commits in a single day. Markets rattled.
IDENTITY CRISIS
@unhappychoice discovers CI has been impersonating a robot for months. Not pleased.
ROBOT EVICTED
@unhappychoice replaces bot author with real name across entire portfolio. Dramatic.
SNAPSHOT DRAMA
@unhappychoice forced to manually update MUI snapshots after 9.3.1 changes tabindex. The audacity.
SOMEWHAT META
@unhappychoice fixes the weekly reporter's git identity. Report now credits itself correctly.
70 APPROVALS
@unhappychoice rubber-stamps 70 PRs across 25 repos. Thumb reportedly exhausted.
TREE-SITTER DRAMA
@unhappychoice refactors lintric traversal for tree-sitter 0.26 iterator API. Witnesses shaken.
